AUTHORITY
Current Stage37 MAIN through M3-T11-227.
Operational predecessor: M3-T11-227.
Mathematical predecessor: M3-T11-226.
Retained inputs used here:
- exact directional host H_j=M2,j disjoint_union M3 and OneTwelfthCorrelationReceiver;
- Stage15/18 shared-edge double-Pythagorean toric host and exact physical height;
- M3-FOUR-001 four-variable E4/H4 dictionary;
- M3-FOUR-LOCAL-001 complete mixed-character bounds;
- M3-FOURIER-001 additive Fourier hierarchy and incomplete-box bound;
- M3-FOUR-NEG-001 elementary double-square-sieve ceiling;
- Stage15-6bu moving-gcd physical-measure firewall;
- Stage15-6ct exact cross-gcd cell/product-height factorization.
Independent hostile audit186–228: NOT RUN.
No endpoint count improvement and no perfect-cuboid existence/nonexistence conclusion.


1. Question fixed by 227


NEXT228 asks whether the A/R1-TF route can be made into one exact Poisson-compatible centered expansion on the full directional host H_j, satisfying all seven conditions:
1) one-object parameterization;
2) exact physical height/no hidden power loss;
3) square/character expansion preserving centering;
4) zero mode exactly equal to product of global marginals;
5) moving separated trace-function coefficients;
6) exceptional loci cheap enough;
7) final Pearson saving stronger than B^(-1/12).


The answer is mixed:
- the full host and all four parity charts can be made exact;
- the finite-field Fourier input extends to all four charts;
- the presently retained square-sieve + absolute Section113 completion architecture still fails before a global centered Poisson theorem can be invoked.


This is a scoped method result, not an impossibility theorem for every future Poisson/delta/switching method.


2. Full directional host: four exact primitive-face charts


Fix one directional host H_j(B). Use physical edges (e,x,y), where e is the labeled shared edge and the two already-integral faces are


    e^2+x^2=u^2,
    e^2+y^2=v^2.


Neither x^2+y^2 nor e^2+x^2+y^2 is imposed.


For coprime positive odd parameters a<b define the primitive Pythagorean functions


    O(a,b)=ab,
    E(a,b)=(b^2-a^2)/2,
    N(a,b)=(a^2+b^2)/2.


Every primitive Pythagorean triple occurs uniquely with odd leg O, even leg E and hypotenuse N in this form.


Take a second coprime positive odd pair c<f. For a chart


    theta=(theta_1,theta_2) in {O,E}^2


let


    L1=theta_1(a,b),
    M1=the other member of {O(a,b),E(a,b)},
    L2=theta_2(c,f),
    M2=the other member of {O(c,f),E(c,f)},


and N1=N(a,b), N2=N(c,f).


Here L1,L2 are the primitive shared-leg values in the two faces. Put


    g=gcd(L1,L2).


For a primitive physical three-edge object the two face scales d1,d2 are coprime. From


    d1 L1=d2 L2


it follows exactly that


    d1=L2/g,
    d2=L1/g.


Hence the physical state is


    e = L1 L2/g,
    x = L2 M1/g,
    y = L1 M2/g,
    u = L2 N1/g,
    v = L1 N2/g.                                  (228.1)


Conversely a primitive labeled two-face state has unique primitive reductions in its two faces; the parity of each primitive shared leg determines theta, and coprimality of the physical face scales forces (228.1). Thus the four theta charts form an exact disjoint finite partition of the labeled directional host, before the usual canonical-order/direction chamber mask is imposed.


No polynomial chart multiplicity is introduced.


RESULT_228_1:
FULL_DIRECTIONAL_FOUR_CHART_PARAMETERIZATION=PROVED_EXACT.
ONE_OBJECT_ONE_CHART_AFTER_LABELS=true.


3. Exact linked-square polynomials and physical height


Define on one theta chart


    E_theta
      := (L2 M1)^2+(L1 M2)^2,                      (228.2)


    H_theta
      := E_theta+(L1 L2)^2.                        (228.3)


Using (228.1),


    E_theta = g^2 (x^2+y^2),
    H_theta = g^2 (e^2+x^2+y^2).                   (228.4)


Therefore the two selectors on the same pre-endpoint H_j measure are exactly


    F=1  iff E_theta is an integer square,
    S=1  iff H_theta is an integer square.          (228.5)


Moreover


    H_theta-E_theta=(L1 L2)^2                      (228.6)


is an explicit square, and the exact physical height is


    R<=B  iff H_theta<=g^2 B^2.                    (228.7)


Thus the linked-square structure from226 has a complete integer/Pythagorean parameter formula on the full directional host, not only on one parity subchart.


RESULT_228_2:
FULL_DIRECTIONAL_LINKED_SQUARE_POLYNOMIALS=PROVED_EXACT.
EXACT_PHYSICAL_HEIGHT_FORMULA=PROVED_EXACT.


4. Relation to the retained E4/H4 chart


For theta=(O,O),


    L1=ab,
    M1=(b^2-a^2)/2,
    L2=cf,
    M2=(f^2-c^2)/2.


Then the retained Section110 polynomials satisfy exactly


    E4 = 4 E_(O,O),
    H4 = 4 H_(O,O).                                (228.8)


So the old E4/H4 finite-field machinery is the O,O chart of the full directional construction.


5. All four charts inherit the Section112/113 finite-field bounds


For one face define the linear change, valid over every odd characteristic,


    T(a,b)=((b-a)/2,(a+b)/2).                      (228.9)


Then


    O(T(a,b)) = E(a,b)/2,
    E(T(a,b)) = O(a,b)/2.                          (228.10)


The determinant of T is nonzero at every odd prime.


If a chart uses E as its primitive shared leg in m of the two faces, apply T to precisely those m parameter pairs. The resulting chart is O,O and


    E_(O,O)(T_theta variables) = 4^(-m) E_theta,
    H_(O,O)(T_theta variables) = 4^(-m) H_theta.   (228.11)


Because 4^m is a square modulo every good odd prime, the quadratic characters of E_theta, H_theta and E_theta H_theta are unchanged after the invertible linear variable substitution.


The additive Fourier transform is also merely reindexed by the inverse-transpose linear map. Since T acts inside one variable pair, the Section113 frequency classes are preserved:
- zero frequency remains zero;
- one-pair-degenerate remains one-pair-degenerate;
- generic nonzero remains generic nonzero.


Therefore, for every one of the four theta charts and every good odd prime p, the retained complete-sum hierarchy extends verbatim in exponent:


    complete zero-frequency character sum: O(p^(7/2)),
    one-pair-degenerate Fourier coefficient: O(p^(5/2)),
    generic nonzero Fourier coefficient: O(p^2),    (228.12)


and the corresponding squarefree incomplete-box estimate has the same exponent shape after the linear chart change.


Caveat:
T need not preserve the integral parity chamber. This theorem is a statement about complete finite-field/Fourier sums at odd p. It does not identify the physical integral domains between charts.


RESULT_228_3:
ALL_FOUR_CHART_LOCAL_CHARACTER_BOUNDS_TRANSFER=true.
ALL_FOUR_CHART_FOURIER_HIERARCHY_TRANSFER=true.
NEW_GLOBAL_SAVING_FROM_THIS_TRANSFER=false.


6. Centered score to be represented


On H_j let


    alpha=M3/H_j,
    beta=(N2,j+P)/H_j,


and


    Z_j
      = sum_{E in H_j} (F(E)-alpha)(S(E)-beta).


By226,


    rho_j = Z_j/sqrt(V_F V_S),                     (228.13)


and a sufficient target is


    |rho_j| << B^(-1/12-delta)                     (228.14)


for one fixed delta>0.


The Poisson adapter therefore must approximate or represent the INTEGER-square indicators in (228.5), not merely the mod-p quadratic-residue indicators.


7. Seven-condition preflight


7.1 Condition 1 — one-object/bounded multiplicity parameterization


PASS.


The four theta charts are exact and disjoint after the labeled physical direction is fixed. Primitive face reductions and scale recovery are unique. Finite chart count is four.


7.2 Condition 2 — exact physical height / no semantic height loss


PASS at the algebraic population level.


Equation (228.7) is the exact physical R<=B cutoff. No raw-height substitution is needed to state the host.


However this does NOT yet give a theorem-compatible rectangular Poisson weight. The cutoff contains the moving


    g=gcd(L1,L2).


Stage15-6bu already proves the relevant firewall in the raw toric variables: using the raw lattice index against raw height counts the wrong primitive physical measure because the moving gcd normalizer is part of the height normalization.


Stage15-6ct supplies an exact cross-gcd cell/product-height factorization, so this is not a semantic mystery. What is absent is a signed Poisson/trace estimate on that exact moving-cell measure.


Thus:
EXACT_HEIGHT_SEMANTICS=PASS.
SEPARATED_SMOOTH_POISSON_WEIGHT_WITH_NO_POWER_LOSS=NOT_PROVED.


7.3 Condition 3 — square/finite-character expansion preserving centering


FAIL for the currently retained square-sieve architecture.


For an integer n,


    1_{n is an integer square}


is not equal to any fixed finite average of Legendre/Jacobi characters. A finite-prime character score detects necessary local quadratic-residue conditions and has false positives.


The standard square-sieve identities/inequalities are designed for nonnegative square counts. Applying them separately to the four terms obtained by expanding


    (F-alpha)(S-beta)


does not preserve the signed cancellation defining the empirical global marginals alpha and beta.


No retained identity supplies an exact bounded-conductor character expansion of both global integer-square selectors on H_j with a controlled centered remainder.


An exact delta/circle representation would be a different method species and would require a fresh conductor/range theorem; it is not contained in Section112/113.


Therefore


    R1_CENTERED_PHYSICAL_SQUARE_SELECTOR_EXPANSION=false.   (228.15)


7.4 Condition 4 — zero mode equals product of GLOBAL marginals


FAIL under the same retained finite-character substitution.


The zero/principal term of a complete finite-field character expansion is a local residue mean, including its zero-divisor corrections. It is not identically


    alpha*beta


where alpha and beta are the empirical integer-square marginals on the physical H_j(B) population.


Centering the local character functions by their mod-p means only produces a locally centered statistic. It does not prove that the global physical zero mode is


    E_H[F] E_H[S].


Promoting that equality would itself require the missing same-measure transfer/equidistribution theorem.


Thus the key R1-TF requirement


    ZERO_FREQUENCY_EXACT_GLOBAL_PRODUCT_OF_MARGINALS


is not certified.


7.5 Condition 5 — nonzero bounded-conductor trace family in genuinely moving separated variables


LOCAL POLYNOMIAL PART: PASS.


Section112/113 now applies to all four chart polynomials by Section5 above.


GLOBAL PHYSICAL COEFFICIENT PART: FAIL / NOT PROVED.


The exact physical coefficient contains:
- primitive pair conditions;
- the canonical/directional chamber;
- the moving gcd g;
- the exact cutoff H_theta<=g^2 B^2.


No retained adapter separates these moving physical weights into one-variable or theorem-compatible coefficient blocks at subpolynomial cost.


Stage15-6bu is a direct warning that an index-q^2 lattice count in the raw four parameters against raw height changes the measure. Stage15-6ct repairs the exact arithmetic bookkeeping but does not provide the needed signed trace-function average over the resulting moving cells.


Therefore the local trace family exists, but the global coefficient-space theorem match does not.


7.6 Condition 6 — diagonal/coincidence/zero-divisor loci cheap enough


NOT PASSED.


Section113 already isolates a one-pair-degenerate contribution in the incomplete bound


    q^(1/2)(AB+CF)


in addition to the generic q^2 remainder. Those strata are controlled locally, but no full physical summation with the square-detector family, moving gcd cells and canonical masks has been shown to fit the 1/12 Pearson budget.


This is not a claim that the exceptional loci are intrinsically large. It is a statement that their required full-family budget is still missing.


7.7 Condition 7 — can the retained square-sieve + Section113 range certify B^(-1/12-delta)?


NO.


There is a useful scoped budget calculation.


Suppose one tries to approximate one square selector by a normalized character score over K distinct primes and controls the replacement in L2 by the standard absolute square-sieve/character second-moment architecture.


The diagonal contribution in that available L2 upper-bound mechanism is on the scale


    H_j/K.                                         (228.16)


To make replacement of F harmless at Pearson scale B^(-1/12), Cauchy requires the squared L2 replacement error to be at most on the scale


    B^(-1/6) V_F.                                  (228.17)


Since alpha->0, V_F is asymptotic in scale to M3. The certified corridor gives only


    M3 >> B^(1/3),
    H_j ~ C_j B(log B)^5.


Thus a proof that works uniformly at the currently certified worst normalization can force the diagonal term (228.16) below (228.17) only after roughly


    K >= B^(5/6-o(1)).                             (228.18)


This is a METHOD-BUDGET statement: smaller K is not mathematically impossible, but the retained absolute L2 estimate does not certify the required replacement error there.


A family of K distinct primes necessarily reaches prime scale at least K^{1-o(1)}. The pair-character moduli appearing in the standard square sieve therefore reach/typically occupy scale at least


    q >= B^(5/3-o(1))                              (228.19)


at the cardinality forced by (228.18).


But the retained Section113 squarefree incomplete-box estimate contains an absolute generic remainder


    q^2,


which at (228.19) is at least


    B^(10/3-o(1)),                                 (228.20)


far above the H_j~B polylog host scale, before the one-pair-degenerate and moving-physical-weight costs are even paid.


Therefore the CURRENT combination


    standard character-score/square-sieve replacement
      + absolute Section113 completion
      + current physical weight handling


cannot certify the 1/12 Pearson receiver.


This does not rule out a new switching theorem, a relative/centered trace theorem, a delta-symbol argument with new cancellation, or another exact global square detector.


8. Consolidated verdict


Seven tests:
1 one-object parameterization: PASS.
2 exact physical height semantics: PASS; separated smooth Poisson weight NOT PROVED.
3 centering-preserving integer-square character expansion: FAIL.
4 zero mode exactly global product-of-marginals: FAIL.
5 local trace family: PASS; global moving coefficient separation: FAIL.
6 exceptional-locus full-family budget: NOT PASSED.
7 1/12 Pearson range with current square-sieve + Section113: FAIL.


Thus the 227 GO condition is not met.


A/R1-TF is returned to HOLD, but with two new exact assets:
- full four-chart directional linked-square parameterization;
- all-chart transfer of the Section112/113 local Fourier hierarchy.


The failed step is now sharply located AFTER local finite-field cancellation and BEFORE a valid global centered square-selector transfer.


9. What can reopen A/R1-TF


Reopen only on genuinely new input of one of these forms:


A. Exact/relative global square detector:
an identity or theorem that represents the integer-square selectors on the exact H_j measure with centered remainder already normalized to V_F,V_S, rather than ambient H_j.


B. Centered physical Poisson/trace theorem:
a theorem operating directly on the moving-gcd/cross-cell physical weight whose principal term is the empirical product of marginals and whose error is <=B^(-1/12-delta) in Pearson normalization.


C. New switching/delta method:
a conductor/range transformation that avoids the q^2 Section113 completion remainder and proves the necessary signed physical covariance estimate.


D. Genuine coefficient separation:
an exact decomposition of the full moving-gcd physical coefficient into theorem-compatible blocks with total energy and family count already within the 1/12 budget.


More complete local character sums, another fixed-prime bound, or another fixed shared-edge sparse-L1 completion do not reopen the route.


10. State and next


M3-T11-GATE-001 remains OPEN.
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0.
P_OVER_M3_LIMIT_PROVED=false.


A/R1-TF current implementation:
HOLD_AFTER_BOUNDED_228_PREFLIGHT.


LOCAL fixed-Q mechanisms remain HOLD from225.
PAIR remains receiver-only.
CROSS-GCD existing automatic stratification remains HOLD.
TQ automatic graph-energy extension remains HOLD.
FIB remains paused without a moving-family theorem.
Fixed-degree geometry is not reopened.
TI remains parked.
216–220 pay sectors remain auxiliary.


NEXT229:
POST_228_NEW_THEOREM_INPUT_ROUTING.


Return to the whole-population portfolio, but compare only routes for which a genuinely new theorem species or internal adapter is now available. Do not issue another A covariance identity/reformulation card. In particular, distinguish:
- new exact global centered-square/trace input;
- new exact-M3 fixed-modulus distribution input;
- new moving-fiber energy input;
- new occupied-image incidence input;
- genuinely new terminal-cover family-uniform geometry.


LATEST_MATH=M3-T11-228.
INDEPENDENT_HOSTILE_AUDIT_186_228=NOT_RUN.
PERFECT_CUBOID_EXISTENCE_OR_NONEXISTENCE_CONCLUSION=NONE.

﻿M3-T11-227 — Post-LOCAL/A whole-population portfolio reaudit

1. Why a new portfolio audit is required


ROUTE-PORTFOLIO-AUDIT-224-R3 selected:
1. LOCAL fixed finite-Q exact-M3 transfer;
2. A centered directional correlation.


M3-T11-225 sharpened LOCAL:
- the fixed-Q receiver is exact;
- Stage13 fixed-S pole-sector transfer does not black-box import to exact M3;
- natural divisor sign/order symmetries preserve the terminal selector;
- LOCAL gate remains OPEN, but current production mechanisms are HOLD.


M3-T11-226 sharpened A:
- exact pre-endpoint host H_j=M2,j disjoint_union M3;
- exact linked-square pair F=1_square(e), S=1_square(e+x^2);
- exact centered score Z_j=D_j/H;
- exact shared-edge x within/between covariance split;
- fixed-x physical fibers are B^o(1);
- fixed-x complete-sum followed by sparse L1 and x-summation is NO_GO;
- A receiver remains OPEN, but the current selected implementation needs a genuinely new moving-family theorem.


Therefore the old priority list cannot simply be repeated.


2. Audit criterion


A route is eligible for immediate production only if it currently has:
(A) an exact same-physical-measure receiver;
(B) an explicit quantitative closure threshold;
(C) a concrete next mechanism that is not already rejected by a firewall;
(D) a bounded preflight whose failure can be recorded without opening another identity chain.


The audit does not rank abstract mathematical beauty or eventual probability of success. It selects the next falsifiable research unit.


3. PAIR-GATE-001


Receiver:
Let W_B be the occupied exact-M3 physical (X,D) image and E_B the endpoint-active subset X^2+D^2=square. Because fixed-(X,D) multiplicity is B^o(1), any
    |E_B| <= B^(-delta+o(1)) |W_B|
closes P/M3.


Current mechanism status:
No occupied-image expansion/incidence theorem is available. M3-T11-225 did not produce one. M3-T11-226 produced a moving shared-edge decomposition on H_j, but not a fixed-power deficit for the M3 occupied (X,D) image.


Important distinction:
PAIR is a sharp receiver, but “fixed-(X,D) multiplicity B^o(1)” is only the fiber half of the argument. The missing image-size/expansion half remains exactly the theorem gate.


Decision:
    PAIR = OPEN RECEIVER / NO INDEPENDENT PRODUCTION MECHANISM.
Do not promote it merely because LOCAL and A are on HOLD.


4. FIB-GATE-001


Receiver:
    sum_t p_t(B)^2 / m_t(B) = o(M3(B))
is sufficient.


Current mechanism status:
Fixed-fiber B^o(1) results do not imply the weighted moving-base second moment. The legacy genus-5/V4 moving-family analysis and literature rematches did not supply a weighted exceptional-base frequency theorem.


M3-T11-226 is conceptually adjacent: its x-partition also shows why bounded fibers alone do not control moving-rate dispersion. But no exact equivalence between the x-base and the canonical fibration t-base is proved, so their savings may not be identified or multiplied.


Decision:
    FIB = PAUSED / NEW MOVING-BASE SECOND-MOMENT THEOREM REQUIRED.


5. CROSS-GCD


Retained from224:
    c_raw=c12*c21,
    E12(B;D) << (B/D)B^o,
    c21^2 divides the raw square detector and is square-neutral.


The threshold-specific physical tail remains OPEN.


But the current Stage14 square-root proof gets its exponent before the c_raw filter can be charged: no fixed-power adapter sends c_raw/q_red into the X13 outer-support deficit.


Decision:
    CROSS_GCD = CONDITIONAL RESERVE.
Reopen only on a genuinely new outer-support/family-average theorem. Another gcd identity, moment, or square-factor observation is not a legal next move.


6. TQ / nonlocal squareclass energy


Receiver:
    Q_H(B)=o(B^(2/3))
closes the ratio.


Retained positive results include high-kernel sectors, fixed-value multiplicity, exact-value energy and bounded-radius graph collisions.


But221–223 prove method firewalls:
- divisor/height/fixed-value information alone does not control off-value same-squareclass energy;
- bounded-degree graph topology plus every fixed-radius sector does not control distant collisions;
- for separated objects the automatic cross-object condition is only the square-product label relation.


Decision:
    TQ = HOLD PENDING A NEW ARITHMETIC DISTRIBUTION THEOREM FOR MOVING J/H LABELS.
No graph-only or identity-only restart.


7. Direct support / content / fresh-S sectors


Cards152–153 and216–220 contain genuine aggregate endpoint-sector theorems:
- prescribed polylog prime alphabet sector negligible;
- all-moving-prime small-cofactor sector negligible;
- several fresh-support / cubefull / radical-height / shared-gcd tails paid.


These are retained as real PAY-SECTORS.


The balanced residual repeatedly survives by keeping every charged visible label below the paid threshold. Cards219–220 add structure without a whole-residual coverage inequality.


Decision:
    DIRECT_SUPPORT_CHAIN = AUXILIARY PAY-SECTORS.
Do not resume “one more content identity” unless a new conservation theorem forces every residual object into already-paid thresholds.


8. Geometry / curves


A correction to the coarse 224-R3 summary is binding:
M3-CURVE-002 already proves that the physical rational degree-6 carrier family on the fixed K_c is finite and its whole degree-6 contribution is O(B^(1/6+o(1))). More generally, retained fixed finite degree bands are not the present global obstruction.


M3-T11-150 already audited the real remaining geometry gate:
- growing degree / moving genus-one carrier families;
- a controlled global carrier assignment and family cost;
- residual Zariski-dense endpoint population.


M3-CURVE-GATE-001 requires BOTH a summable accumulating-family theorem and residual surface control.


Decision:
    GEOMETRY = LIVE PARTIAL GATE BUT NOT CURRENT PRODUCTION ROUTE.
Do not reopen degree-6 or another fixed-degree classification. A legitimate restart needs a new residual rational-point theorem or a growing-family union theorem under exact physical height.


9. Denominator upgrade


Receiver:
    M3(B) >> B^(1/2+delta)
would close against the existing endpoint upper.


Current certified lower scale is B^(1/3), and no new exact high-dimensional construction above exponent1/2 is present.


Decision:
    DEN = LOW / PAUSED.
No new parameter family should be counted unless its physical-height dimension/fiber budget can exceed1/2.


10. PESCH-TI


The gate remains high leverage:
an o(M3) bound for the two-source TI-hard locus closes Stage37.


But the needed weighted hard-locus theorem remains open, the1072 aggregate remains HOLD, and the user explicitly parked TI.


Decision:
    TI = PARKED.
Ordinary stage37mainbatch does not auto-reopen it.


11. Cross-Stage / theorem-arsenal rematch


A Drive-wide rematch for moving-family, same-measure correlation, weighted moving-base second moments and linked-square cancellation found no retained DIRECT theorem for the Stage37 receivers.


The closest theorem species remain adapter-dependent:
- bilinear forms with trace functions over sparse/arbitrary supports;
- uniform trace-function stratification and bilinear trace bounds;
- Poisson / q-van-der-Corput architectures;
- Stage14 moving-prime / normalized-core bilinear reductions.


The existing Stage37 legacy Section18 already identified exactly the corresponding A-route implementation:
    R1-TF = DirectionalToricSelectorPoissonTrace.


Its missing adapter was:
produce an exact smoothed integer-parameter formula on H_j such that
- primitive/canonical multiplicity is exact;
- R<=B is retained without power loss;
- centering is performed before sparse M3 conditioning;
- the zero mode is the correct product-of-marginals contribution;
- nonzero modes form a bounded-complexity trace-function family;
- exceptional coincidence loci and coefficient energies are explicit.


At the time that adapter was proposed, the pre-endpoint centered host itself had not been reduced to the exact linked-square/shared-edge form now proved in226.


Thus226 supplies genuinely new input to the OLD Poisson/trace adapter task:
    H_j exact host,
    F=1_square(e),
    S=1_square(e+x^2),
    Z_j exact centered score,
    x-moving within/between decomposition,
    1/12-plus-margin quantitative budget.


This does NOT prove a trace-function estimate. It does make one bounded adapter re-entry non-circular and more concrete than before.


12. Updated route selection


No unparked route currently has a ready-made theorem that closes a positive proportion of the whole unresolved population.


The best next bounded mechanism test is nevertheless A/R1-TF, for four reasons:
1. it starts before sparse M3 conditioning on the large exact host H_j;
2. the exact closure margin is only 1/12 plus a fixed delta, not an absolute B^(1/3) endpoint bound;
3.226 now supplies the exact linked-square and moving-x centered decomposition needed to state the coefficient problem without ambiguity;
4. recent/retained trace-function machinery has a recognizable theorem contract once coefficient separation and exceptional loci are certified, whereas PAIR/FIB/CROSS/TQ/geometry presently lack even that adapter-level match.


This is a bounded REENTRY, not a declaration that A is solved or globally preferred forever.


DECISION:
    A_DIRECTIONAL_POISSON_TRACE_ADAPTER = SELECTED_BOUNDED_REENTRY.
    LOCAL_CURRENT_MECHANISMS = HOLD.
    PAIR = RECEIVER_ONLY.
    FIB = PAUSED.
    CROSS_GCD = CONDITIONAL_RESERVE.
    TQ = HOLD.
    DIRECT_SUPPORT_152_220 = AUXILIARY_PAY_SECTORS.
    GEOMETRY_FIXED_DEGREE = DO_NOT_REOPEN.
    GEOMETRY_GLOBAL_TWO_LAYER_GATE = PAUSED.
    DEN = LOW.
    TI = PARKED.
    GLOBAL_CREDIT=0.

﻿M3-T11-226 — Pre-endpoint shared-edge linked-square covariance split


STATUS: PROVED_EXACT_PREENDPOINT_LINKED_SQUARE_FORM / PROVED_SHARED_EDGE_TOTAL_COVARIANCE_SPLIT / PROVED_FIXED_SHARED_EDGE_FIBER_B_O1 / NO_GO_FIXED_X_COMPLETE_SUM_PLUS_SPARSE_L1 / MOVING_X_RATE_DISPERSION_RECEIVER_OPEN / A_CURRENT_IMPLEMENTATION_HOLD_PENDING_NEW_MOVING_FAMILY_THEOREM / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0.


Authority:
- current Stage37 MAIN through M3-T11-225;
- ROUTE-PORTFOLIO-AUDIT-224-R3;
- active T11 route NEXT226;
- M3-ROOT-001;
- M3-A-001 / M3-A-GATE-001 / M3-A-LOCAL-001;
- legacy-cold Sections13,18,19;
- M3-T11-159 and M3-T11-213/214 firewalls;
- StructureRadar SR-STR-161/165/166/169/173 theorem contracts.


Gate OPEN. No retraction. Independent hostile audit186–226 NOT RUN. TI remains parked.


1. Question


NEXT226 asks for the actual directional PRE-ENDPOINT host before either the missing-third-face selector or the space-diagonal selector is conditioned away, and for one centered moving-family coefficient structure that can be compared honestly with the M3-A-001 budget


    |rho_j(B)| << B^(-1/12-delta).


The first version of this preflight considered restricting to an odd-shared-edge divisor subchart. That restriction is unnecessary and would not by itself represent the full audited directional host. The exact reduction below therefore uses the full shared-edge host H_j and partitions only by its actual shared edge x.


2. Exact pre-endpoint directional host


Fix one missing-face direction j.


The audited directional host is


    H_j(B) = M2,j(B) disjoint_union M3(B),


with exact primitive/canonical physical height R<=B.


Write a physical state in this direction as positive edges


    (x,y,z),


where x is the distinguished shared edge and the two already-required faces satisfy


    x^2+y^2 = q_y^2,
    x^2+z^2 = q_z^2


for integers q_y,q_z.


No condition is imposed yet on y^2+z^2 or on x^2+y^2+z^2.


Define Boolean selectors on this SAME H_j measure:


    F(E) = 1_{y^2+z^2 is a square},
    S(E) = 1_{x^2+y^2+z^2 is a square}.


Thus F is the missing-third-face selector and S is the space-diagonal selector before either is conditioned away.


This is exactly the pre-endpoint population required by M3-A-001 and avoids the endpoint-conditioned saturation of159 by construction.


3. Exact linked-square normal form


Put


    e(E) = y^2+z^2.


Then on every E in H_j,


    F(E) = 1_square(e),
    S(E) = 1_square(e+x^2).                         (226.1)


Therefore the two terminal selectors form an exact LINKED-SQUARE pair whose radicands differ by the square x^2.


No ambient box, residue replacement, or extra density assumption is used in (226.1).


In particular, on F=1 with d^2=e, the remaining S condition is exactly


    d^2+x^2 = square,


so endpoint completion is a second Pythagorean completion on the same physical object. This identity is structural only; it is not charged as a new saving.


4. Global centered score and exact root normalization


Let


    H = |H_j(B)| = M2,j+M3,
    alpha = E_H[F] = M3/H,
    beta  = E_H[S] = (N2,j+P)/H.


Define the raw centered score


    Z_j(B)
      = sum_{E in H_j(B)} (F(E)-alpha)(S(E)-beta).  (226.2)


Let


    D_j = M2,j*P - M3*N2,j.


The directional 2x2 table gives exactly


    Z_j = H*Cov_j(F,S)
        = D_j/H.                                    (226.3)


Also define the unnormalized selector variances


    V_F = sum_H (F-alpha)^2
        = H*alpha*(1-alpha),


    V_S = sum_H (S-beta)^2
        = H*beta*(1-beta).                          (226.4)


Then the Pearson coefficient in M3-A-001 is exactly


    rho_j = Z_j / sqrt(V_F V_S).                    (226.5)


Consequently the M3-A-001 sufficient budget becomes the raw-score target


    |Z_j|
      << B^(-1/12-delta) sqrt(V_F V_S)              (226.6)


for some fixed delta>0, with the inherited log/epsilon bookkeeping.


The one-sided root receiver is even simpler:


    Z_j^+ = o(M3)                                   (226.7)


is sufficient for P/M3 -> 0, because
Cov_j(F,S)_+=Z_j^+/H and alpha=M3/H.


Equations (226.2)–(226.7) are on the exact pre-endpoint physical measure.


5. Partition by the actual shared edge


For each positive integer x define the exact physical fiber


    H_{j,x}(B)
      = {E in H_j(B): shared edge(E)=x},


and let


    n_x = |H_{j,x}|.


For n_x>0 define


    alpha_x = E[F | x],
    beta_x  = E[S | x],
    gamma_x = E[FS | x].


Then


    sum_x n_x alpha_x = H alpha,
    sum_x n_x beta_x  = H beta,
    sum_x n_x gamma_x = P.


The law of total covariance gives the exact split


    Z_j = C_within + C_between,                     (226.8)


where


    C_within
      = sum_x n_x (gamma_x-alpha_x beta_x),         (226.9)


and


    C_between
      = sum_x n_x (alpha_x-alpha)(beta_x-beta).     (226.10)


This is the first exact moving-family decomposition of the M3-A centered score on its audited pre-endpoint host.


It separates two logically different tasks:


A. within-x linked-square correlation;
B. moving-x covariance of the two selector survival rates.


Neither term may be dropped or renamed as the other.


6. Uniform fixed-x physical fiber bound


For fixed x, every positive y with x^2+y^2=q_y^2 satisfies


    (q_y-y)(q_y+y)=x^2.                             (226.11)


Hence the number of possible y is at most the divisor count of x^2 up to an absolute parity/order factor:


    #y << tau(x^2).


The same holds for z. Therefore


    n_x << tau(x^2)^2 = B^o(1)                     (226.12)


uniformly for x<=B.


All primitive/canonical/height masks only reduce the count, so (226.12) is valid on the exact physical directional host.


This is not a density saving for H_j: the B^o(1) fibers move through polynomially many x.


7. Exact moving-rate dispersion receiver


Define between-fiber dispersion energies


    V_F^btw
      = sum_x n_x (alpha_x-alpha)^2,


    V_S^btw
      = sum_x n_x (beta_x-beta)^2.                 (226.13)


Cauchy on the SAME x-weighted physical measure gives


    |C_between|
      <= sqrt(V_F^btw V_S^btw).                    (226.14)


The Bernoulli variance decomposition is exact:


    V_F
      = sum_x n_x alpha_x(1-alpha_x) + V_F^btw,


    V_S
      = sum_x n_x beta_x(1-beta_x) + V_S^btw.      (226.15)


Thus


    eta_F = V_F^btw/V_F,
    eta_S = V_S^btw/V_S


lie in [0,1], and the normalized between-fiber contribution satisfies


    |C_between|/sqrt(V_F V_S)
      <= sqrt(eta_F eta_S).                         (226.16)


Therefore a sufficient moving-family theorem for the BETWEEN part is


    eta_F eta_S
      << B^(-1/6-2delta)                            (226.17)


for some fixed delta>0.


Equivalently it is enough to power-control one of the two moving survival-rate dispersions strongly enough, since the other eta is at most1.


This is an explicit 1/12-plus-margin coefficient-energy budget, not generic squareclass energy.


8. Fixed-x complete-sum / sparse-L1 architecture is insufficient


The fixed-x fibers satisfy only


    n_x=B^o(1).


Therefore a method that:


1. proves a complete finite-field or complete-curve character bound at fixed x;
2. transfers it to the actual physical H_{j,x} by taking only the L1 mass of that sparse fiber;
3. then sums over x,


can recover at best a bound on the scale


    sum_x n_x = H_j
              ~ C_j B(log B)^5,                    (226.18)


up to subpolynomial factors.


But the one-sided centered target is already


    Z_j^+ = o(M3),


with M3 >> B^(1/3).


Hence the fixed-x-complete-sum + sparse-L1 architecture supplies no required global power deficit.


Decision:


    FIXED_SHARED_EDGE_COMPLETE_SUM_PLUS_SPARSE_L1 = NO_GO.  (226.19)


This is the same transfer obstruction seen abstractly in213/214, now stated directly on the actual M3-A pre-endpoint directional fibers.


It does NOT rule out:
- an x-averaged bilinear/Poisson theorem;
- a same-measure linked-square correlation theorem;
- a genuine coefficient separation across moving x;
- a new charged-once eliminant.


9. Existing theorem-contract rematch


SR-STR-161:
usable only after genuine one-variable coefficient separation. The x-fiber split (226.8) is not such a separation; arbitrary correlated moving weights remain outside its contract.


SR-STR-165:
requires exact one-ideal coefficient separation plus conductor/ray-class bookkeeping. No such adapter follows from (226.1)–(226.12).


SR-STR-166:
requires a new charged-once determinant/eliminant or an exact inverse-fraction transform. The linked-square identity alone creates neither.


SR-STR-169:
this is precisely the same-measure signed physical-selector correlation species. It remains EXTERNAL_GATE; complete traces or conductor energy are not independent savings.


SR-STR-173:
supports same-measure moment bookkeeping/firewalls but gives no fixed-power covariance estimate.


M3-A-LOCAL-001:
first-order local blocker supports are generically separate, but that local O(p^-2) interaction does not bound C_within or the moving-rate dispersion (226.13).


Thus no retained theorem currently proves either:
- C_within at the 1/12-plus-margin scale; or
- eta_F eta_S << B^(-1/6-c).


10. Decision


New exact results:
- the correct full pre-endpoint H_j host is explicit before either selector is conditioned;
- F and S are the linked-square pair e and e+x^2;
- the raw centered M3-A score is Z_j=D_j/H and has the exact 1/12 Pearson budget;
- partition by the actual shared edge x gives the exact within/between covariance split;
- every fixed-x physical fiber has B^o(1) size;
- the between term reduces to the moving survival-rate dispersion product eta_F eta_S;
- fixed-x complete-sum plus sparse-L1 completion is a method-level NO_GO.


What is NOT proved:
- no bound on C_within with a fixed power;
- no fixed-power decay of eta_F or eta_S;
- no M3-A Pearson decay;
- no endpoint upper-bound improvement.


Therefore:


    PREENDPOINT_HOST_CONSTRUCTION = PASS.
    SHARED_EDGE_LINKED_SQUARE_REDUCTION = PROVED_EXACT.
    SHARED_EDGE_TOTAL_COVARIANCE_SPLIT = PROVED_EXACT.
    FIXED_SHARED_EDGE_FIBER_B_O1 = PROVED_EXACT.
    FIXED_X_COMPLETE_SUM_PLUS_SPARSE_L1 = NO_GO.
    MOVING_X_RATE_DISPERSION_RECEIVER = OPEN.
    CURRENT_RETAINED_THEOREM_MATCH = NONE.
    M3_A_GATE_001 = OPEN_RECEIVER.
    A_CURRENT_SELECTED_IMPLEMENTATION = HOLD_PENDING_NEW_MOVING_FAMILY_THEOREM.
    GLOBAL_CREDIT = 0.


11. Next

Therefore the next bounded unit should NOT rename the A covariance again.
